title: Optimal \(\ell\)\(_{1}\) distortion of planar Earth Mover Distance
formal: What is the optimal bi-Lipschitz distortion for embedding the earthmover metric on probability measures on an n by n planar grid into \(l_{1}\)?

sentences: Earth Mover Distance measures the cheapest transportation of one probability distribution into another across a planar grid.
The problem asks how well this entire metric can be embedded into \(\ell\)\(_{1}\) while preserving every pairwise distance.
Its parameter is the side length of the grid, and the target is the optimal dependence of distortion on that size.
A single coordinate representation must accommodate many different transportation patterns.
Understanding this loss would clarify the limits of treating geometric transport as ordinary coordinatewise comparison or sketching.
